meetings.title: Harbor QBR prep
transcript: Jordan: The QBR is at two. The deck covers Q3 usage, the export fix and the new time zone display.
Maya: Arjun, can you speak to the Sep 28 outage if Dana asks?
Arjun: Yes. The postmortem is done, and the retry queue goes to production tomorrow.
Jordan: Last time their ops lead asked how we would know about an outage before they do.
Arjun: Nina's error-rate alert covers that.
Maya: Dana also wants the renewal terms on one page. Jordan, can you make a ticket for me?
Maya: Anything else they might raise?
Jordan: The weekly usage report. They liked the first one.
